verdict.line: You outtrade and can solo-kill Garen before level 6, but the matchup still posts only a 45.2% win rate over 1008 games, so a won lane does not guarantee a won game.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's E (Test of Spirit, cooldown 16/15/14/13/12s) rips a spirit from Garen and echoes a percentage of the damage you do to it back onto his real health bar, which lets you burst through his Perseverance passive regen before it can tick him back up. That mechanic is why OP.GG marks Illaoi with both the lane and solo-kill edge here. The catch is the overall number still sits below 50%, meaning Illaoi players win the early 1v1 more often than they convert it into the rest of the game.

theirWindow.what: Once he hits 6, Demacian Justice (cooldown 140/110/80/50/20s, range 400) can execute a badly damaged target outright. Don't commit E or stand in Judgment range when you're already chunked — bank your spirit damage and reset instead of forcing the kill.

yourWindow.when: Right after he fires Q (Decisive Strike)
yourWindow.what: Decisive Strike has an 8s cooldown and is his only gap-close, slow-cleanse, and silence. The moment it's spent, leap in with W (Harsh Lesson) and follow with E — he has no tool left to disengage or punish you back.

start.why: Highest-winrate start (46.8% over 788 games) — the extra sustain and early AD let you win the E-into-auto trades without losing the attrition war to his passive.

boots.why: Most-picked boots at 46.6% winrate; cuts down the physical damage from his auto-resets and Judgment (E) spin during extended duels.

core.why: Rush this — the armor shred lets your E spirit-echo and tentacle damage chew through him faster than Perseverance can heal it back.
Highest-winrate core path pairs this second (61.4% over 57 games) — the HP and tenacity keep you alive through his Judgment spam and into his level-6 execute threat.
Closes out the strongest measured path — delaying damage taken is a direct counter to Demacian Justice trying to execute you off one hit.

runes.keystoneWhy: The most-picked page (43%) for this matchup — Grasp's proc timer lines up with your W (Harsh Lesson, 4s cooldown) engage rhythm, giving you a heal on every trade that offsets his Perseverance regen instead of racing it.

summoners.why: Exhaust + Flash is the best-performing combo measured here (47.2% winrate) — Exhaust lets you shut down his Decisive Strike engage burst and extend your own all-in. Flash + Teleport (48.6% pick) is the safer macro choice if you'd rather reset and split-push instead of forcing kills.

playing.title: Punish his engage with W
playing.detail: The instant Garen commits Q (Decisive Strike) to engage, leap onto him with W (Harsh Lesson) — his gap-close is now on an 8s cooldown and nearby tentacles swing on him too.

playing.title: Burst before Perseverance ticks
playing.detail: Land E (Test of Spirit) and immediately follow with autos and Q so the echoed damage lands before his passive regen kicks back in — a slow poke war favors him, a fast burst favors you.

playing.title: Respect post-6 execute threat
playing.detail: Once he's level 6, don't stay in Judgment (E, range 325) range while low — Demacian Justice can end the fight outright, so disengage before you're the kill target.

playing.title: Hold E for overextensions
playing.detail: Test of Spirit's 16-12s cooldown is precious — save it for when he pushes too far up, not as a poke tool, since killing the spirit converts him into a Vessel feeding you tentacles.

playing.title: Track his Q cooldown all lane
playing.detail: Decisive Strike is his only slow-cleanse and silence; knowing when it's down tells you exactly when an all-in is safe versus when he can punish you back.

playing.title: Zone with tentacles
playing.detail: Use Q (Tentacle Smash) near terrain to keep tentacles active — they heal you on champion hits and punish him for walking up to clear waves or trade.

playing.title: Convert your lead before 14
playing.detail: His sustain and split-push catch up from level 14 on, so use your early kill pressure to force objectives and fights rather than passively scaling even.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are pulled from measured games on the current patch (OP.GG); the mechanical reasoning, timings, and trade patterns are my own tactical read, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Garen will try to fall back after engaging to restore health back up with his (P), so use [Q] or [E] to either deactivate (P) or nuke him for a kill. Garen will try to get a kill with (R) after reaching level 6, so be careful when your health is low.
